_about: HEADER rows of real CIQ exports, frozen 2026-10-27 from the assembler's copy (mosaic-theory-ta/data/manual/ciq) for the stated-currency pins: each sheet's 'Currency' row, 'In Millions of …' line, 'Currency:' cells, period headers and Estimates section headers — exactly what ciq_sheets.stated_currency reads, and NO CIQ figure (an Estimates row keeps only its label, section and period cells). Keyed '<kind>|<freq>|<sheet>'; 'sha' names each export by the first 10 hex of its sha256, as the pages stamp them.
